note: Milestones are what the founder tests, in order. Add steps with kit_roadmap_add or by editing this file, then run render and validate.

milestones.title: Baseline ready
milestones.purpose: The repository is trustworthy for agents and for CI before anything new is built.
milestones.can_test: Run every test with one command, see CI run, and start the app from a clean clone.
founder_test: Run the single test command from the setup guide; it prints counts and ends in success.
Break one test on purpose and run it again; it must fail.
Open a pull request and watch CI run the checks.
Start the app from a clean clone using docs/SETUP.md.

milestones.title: First usable slice
milestones.purpose: The smallest thing the founder would call usable, as defined in VISION.md.
milestones.can_test: Use the first slice end to end as the intended user would.

steps.title: Turn the first release in VISION.md into 3 to 6 concrete steps with exit evidence
steps.exit: milestones.json M1 holds 3 to 6 real steps (replacing this one), each with a lane and checkable exit evidence; validate passes; the founder confirmed the list.
steps.defers: everything not in the first release

founder_test: Use the first slice end to end the way the intended user would; every step in the milestone's test script works.
skips: Anything not in the first release.
